customer_purchase: visible repeatable meal with ingredient choice and convenient pickup
economic_control_point: company-owned restaurants menu simplicity Chipotlanes and digital ordering
main_burden_carrier: company labor food packaging real estate training and service quality
current_evidence: FY2025 revenue 11926M; OCF 2114M; capex 666.3M; buybacks 2426M; Q2 2026 comps 2.2%; transactions 1.0%; average check 1.2%
qoe_or_shenanigans_test: split transactions from check and mix; test food labor packaging digital and occupancy cost plus new-store payback
owner_cash_denominator: store cash after operating costs maintenance new-store capital taxes and dilution
valuation_and_macro_boundary: price must assume durable traffic margin and store returns; stress affordability labor food inflation and rates
thesis_breaker: transactions or margin reverse while check growth and promotions mask weaker stores; new stores fail payback

customer_purchase: familiar fast low-friction meal and occasion
economic_control_point: franchise property locations loyalty data price architecture and restaurant technology
main_burden_carrier: franchisees workers suppliers discounted customers and parent property system
current_evidence: Q2 2026 US comparable sales rose while guest counts fell; rewards members more than double first-year visits claim; 5 Meal Deal McValue Ready on Arrival and Grinch-socks campaign
qoe_or_shenanigans_test: test guest counts versus price mix; loyalty pre/post behavior; discount allocation; franchisee margin and technology productivity
owner_cash_denominator: parent rent and fee cash plus required property technology brand and capital support less franchisee and discount burdens
valuation_and_macro_boundary: price must assume repeat visits and durable franchise economics; stress household affordability wages rates and promotion burden
thesis_breaker: guest counts stay negative after value campaigns or franchisee economics deteriorate without productivity gains

customer_purchase: materials delivery project knowledge and trade access for property upkeep
economic_control_point: stores SRS/GMS branches inventory delivery assets Pro relationships and job-site fulfillment
main_burden_carrier: suppliers store and delivery labor contractors property owners and integration funding system
current_evidence: FY2025 sales 164.7B; comps 0.3%; adjusted operating margin 13.1%; Q1 2026 sales 41.8B; comps 0.6%; over 1300 SRS branches; about 16000 delivery assets
qoe_or_shenanigans_test: separate organic demand from SRS/GMS; test inventory receivables supplier terms delivery cost integration and maintenance capital
owner_cash_denominator: normalized cash after inventory and receivable funding distribution capital integration leases taxes debt and dilution
valuation_and_macro_boundary: price must assume Pro throughput and upkeep demand offset housing weakness; stress rates housing turnover materials inflation and credit terms
thesis_breaker: Pro cross-sell and upkeep fail to offset housing weakness while integration and working-capital burdens rise
